summary: Approval: time-boxed aggregated session dump (redacted) for security investigation
description: Request from Security to produce an aggregated, redacted snapshot of user session metadata and non-sensitive model telemetry to support an ongoing phishing investigation. This is not a full raw export — the goal is a minimized, inspectable artifact that preserves sequence-level timing and routing characteristics but strips or tokenizes any potential PII and model outputs. Requestor: Security (Ben Carter). Context: post-alert triage for suspicious account activity impacting three enterprise customers.
impact: Investigative need only; dataset will be used by Security and Legal to determine scope of suspected account compromise. Low risk if redaction is performed correctly; high compliance risk if raw customer outputs or unredacted PII are exposed.
requested_artifacts: aggregated session timeline (session ids + event timestamps)
route-level latency histogram for selected buckets
tokenized prompt/response fingerprints (hashes) only — no cleartext outputs
config snapshot (model version, kernel hints) for the affected time window
redaction_plan: 1) Exclude full-text model outputs. 2) Replace user identifiers and email-like tokens with deterministic pseudonyms (UID-<hash>). 3) Hash prompts/responses with SHA256 and include only the first 8 chars of the hex as a fingerprint. 4) Strip any detected PII using the PII detection rule set v3.2. 5) Manual spot-check by Compliance on a 1% sample prior to sharing. All steps recorded in the artifact manifest.
access_duration: Read-only access to the generated artifact for Security + Legal for 48 hours after delivery; artifact must be deleted from temporary storage at expiry and deletion confirmed in ticket.
steps_to_produce_dump: 2. Run serving-runtime aggregated query job with --include-metadata --exclude-fulloutputs flags.
3. Pipe raw output through redaction pipeline (pii-scrub v3.2 + token hashing).
4. Store artifact in temporary S3 bucket with restricted ACL and server-side encryption.
5. Notify Compliance for 1% manual sample review.
6. Upon approval, grant read-only signed URL to approvers and attach manifest to ticket.
investigation_notes: Initial alert triggered by anomaly detector: unusual ratio of streaming disconnects to token counts for three customer orgs.
Affected model variants: rwd-1-large and rwd-1-quantized (snapshot at 2026-03-04).
Preliminary metric: 3x increase in prefix retransmissions; likely caused by network retries affecting streaming join logic.
No evidence yet of exfiltration of customer outputs; need fingerprints to correlate with customer-reported samples.
resolution: Pending approval. Compliance requested minor change to redaction plan (include salt for pseudonym hashes). Action: SRE to add salt and rerun a fresh sample for Compliance sign-off.
